fields.notes: LPDDR5 (JESD209-5) does not specify a formal in-system scan / JTAG architecture at the DRAM balls. Bus-level DFT is limited to MRR, RDCAL / Read-FIFO / Write-FIFO training, WCK2CK sync, ZQ calibration, and Link-ECC status. Internal DRAM scan / BIST / repair is vendor-proprietary.

exposed_dft_features.name: Mode Register Read (MRR)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: In-band read of device-info / operating-mode / refresh / status mode registers.

exposed_dft_features.name: Read DQ Calibration (RDCAL) / Read FIFO
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Deterministic calibration pattern / FIFO for read-path training.

exposed_dft_features.name: Write FIFO
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Known pattern through the write path for write-path training.

exposed_dft_features.name: WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Validates the WCK-to-CK phase-lock / clock path.

exposed_dft_features.name: Link ECC status
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Flags corrected single-bit errors on the wire.

exposed_dft_features.name: ZQ calibration
exposed_dft_features.purpose: On-die impedance calibration against the external reference resistor.

exposed_dft_features.name: Per-state IDD specifications
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Per-state current points for power-state characterization.

fields.no_jtag_on_DRAM_balls: LPDDR5 SDRAM has no JTAG / boundary-scan / scan-shift pins at the package interface; vendor scan/BIST runs at wafer probe.
controller_side_dft_aids: Per-byte-lane PHY observability: RX FIFO, WCK2CK leveling state, per-bit deskew, eye-margin sweeps, DFE taps, Vref training results via a vendor control register interface.
Logic-analyzer / oscilloscope probing of CK / WCK / RDQS / CA[6:0] / CS / DQ / DMI.
RDCAL fixed pattern as a deterministic read self-test.
Link-ECC error counters and controller-side system ECC.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
